title: The moving four-point path yields an exact quartic Legendre and packet gain over the moving three-point branch

transfer.optimized_shape_consequence: On K1697's compact interior neighborhood of small-g rectangular minimizers, the moving four-point envelope is strictly lower than the moving three-point envelope by at least c_4g^4+o(g^4) for some c_4>0.

scope_guard: The transfer uses the K1683 scalar-product rectangular trial and the weak-reward expansion. Shape motion can change the exact optimized quartic constant, and no unrestricted lower bound follows.
